n: With a vaulted lounge, an annexe and about a quarter of an acre
h: Former stables turned five-bedroom home with vaulted lounge
why: Page read 22 Nov: the listing describes it as a characterful family home, formerly stables, freehold end terrace of 2,509 sq ft on about 0.24 acres. Stables were not built for living in, so it fits the remit, though it may be one unit of a converted stable range rather than the whole building; the description beyond the key features was not read in full. Matched the 'granary' alert, but the listing says stables, not granary
